name: Huckleberry Hollow Blueberry Farm
description: Huckleberry Hollow Blueberry Farm is a working farm in Saint Clair, MO. It grows Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Pumpkins, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
